title: Payments API latency spike
symptoms: p99 latency jumped from 180ms to 4.2s. Checkout timeouts increased 18%. Postgres showed 'too many connections'.
root_cause: Connection pool max_overflow was 0 after a config rollout. Idle connections were held by a leaked SQLAlchemy session in the refunds worker.
resolution: Rolled back pool settings, recycled leaked sessions, raised pool_size to 20 and max_overflow to 10, then restarted the refunds worker.

title: Redis cache stampede on product catalog
symptoms: Catalog 5xx burst after cache TTL expiry. Redis CPU at 95%. Origin Postgres query rate 20x normal.
root_cause: All product keys shared the same TTL. A deploy cleared the cache with no request coalescing.
resolution: Enabled singleflight on cache miss, staggered TTLs, and warmed top 5k SKUs before traffic was restored.

title: Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff on ingest workers
symptoms: ingest-worker pods restarting every 40s. Kafka lag grew to 12 million messages. OOMKilled in events.
root_cause: Batch size was increased to 5k without raising memory limits. A poison JSON payload also allocated a huge object graph.
resolution: Reverted batch size to 500, raised memory limit to 1Gi, quarantined the poison offset, and added a payload size guard.
